name: novaaio
description: NovaAIO - AI agent desktop application. Unified launcher for the agent backend and Next.js HUD.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:agent && npm run lint:hud
scripts.lint:agent: npm run typecheck:agent && node ./hud/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config eslint.agent.config.mjs --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern nova.js "src/**/*.js" "src/**/*.mjs" "scripts/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run build:agent-core && npm run test:node
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:agent && npm run typecheck:hud
scripts.typecheck:hud: npx tsc --noEmit -p hud/tsconfig.json && npm run guard:hud-integrations-secrets
scripts.smoke:fundamental: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:local-db && npm run smoke:encryption && npm run smoke:security-guard && npm run smoke:src-security && npm run smoke:src-tools && npm run smoke:routing-core && npm run smoke:agent-tasks && npm run smoke:token-gate && npm --prefix hud run test:smoke
